notablePrerequisites:
There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
You control at least one colored legendary creature or planeswalker.
description:
Cast Mox Amber by paying its mana cost.
When Mox Amber enters, Surge Conductor triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artfacts you control.
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mox Amber, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Mox Amber from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Mox Amber.
Repeat.
